synth.notes:
Reused a prior passing frame-native mirror-axis rule unchanged except header (160 lines, stateless).
Board = 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: axis ring 10, targets 11 solid, pieces ring 5, reflections ring/centre 4 at row 2A-r.
A1/A2 move selection up/down, A3/A4 move selected piece left/right, blocked by edge/other pieces; axis ignores A3/A4.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; selected piece/axis centres drawn 0; merged pieces split by growing from 0-centres.
HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective action; open: whether piece rows block the axis (not exercised).
